title: Total Wake Time
formula: total wake time = initial sleep latency + WASO
lesson: Total wake time across the recording includes wake before sleep onset plus wake after sleep onset. It can also be found by subtracting total sleep time from total recording time.
memoryClue: Total wake combines the wake before sleep and the wake after sleep begins.
coachBobNote: If the problem asks for WASO only, do not include initial sleep latency. If it asks for total wake, include both.

workedExample.prompt: Initial sleep latency is 25 minutes and WASO is 50 minutes. Find total wake time.

guided.prompt: TRT 480 min and TST 405 min. Find total wake time.

commonErrors.message: That may represent WASO alone. Total wake also includes wake before sleep onset.

guided.prompt: Initial sleep latency 20 min and WASO 45 min. Find total wake time.
